payload.rationale: This sprint retro directly references the async decision widget (Position_Sprint4ThesisProven, Position_CoreFeatureDecisionCapture), velocity 23 points (Obs_TinaVelocity, StyleObs_Sprint4_MetricAnchor), and Zephyr integration (Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock) — all witnessed in the prior Sprint 4 Retro (Sample_Sprint4Retro_20260322). I expanded the full narrative ecosystem: Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning and Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate frame the product thesis, while Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus is the core insight the widget embodies. I also included adjacent positions from the prior retro that this new retro could update or bear on: Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint (next sprint focus may shift), Position_WebhookArchitecture (technical underpinning of the widget), both pricing positions (PricingTwelveDollars and PricingTier25Plus), and the anti-pattern/category/target-market positions that define the product frame. No areas were deliberately excluded — the document is short but sits at the center of the entire graph.
